subject.title: Design: run lifecycle reliability — bounded liveness, abort⇒release, crash resume, completion drive

question: Should maintainers adopt this issue as the canonical staged run-lifecycle reliability umbrella, or narrow it back to the existing bug-specific reports?
rationale: Source evidence supports the problem class, but the proposed fix chooses lifecycle ownership, liveness policy, crash persistence, and Codex-wrapper behavior across stable gateway and agent surfaces.

options.title: Adopt staged umbrella
options.body: Approve the four invariants as the maintainer-owned direction and split Track A-D into focused PRs with source and live proof.

options.title: Approve Track A only
options.body: Treat abort-to-release and stale-lane takeover as the near-term approved scope while deferring durability and completion-drive decisions.

options.title: Keep reports separate
options.body: Decline the umbrella and continue landing narrower fixes against the linked production reports without making this canonical.

recommendation.title: Adopt staged umbrella
recommendation.body: Approve the four invariants as the maintainer-owned direction and split Track A-D into focused PRs with source and live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus authored, self-assigned, and opened the first linked Track A PR, making them the clearest owner for whether this becomes canonical.
